# Generated by npm run desktop:prepare

This folder is filled by `prepare-standalone.mjs` before `tauri build`.

Expected entry after prepare:

```
apps/web/server.js
```

Tauri embeds this tree as `$RESOURCE/standalone/` via the `bundle.resources` map in `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` (`../resources/standalone/` → `standalone/`).
